item.title: Read The Top News Headlines For Friday 9 January In One Click
item.description: Stay updated with the biggest headlines for Friday, 9 January- politics, crime, sports, and more - all summarized for quick reading. Get instant access to breaking news, major developments, and trending stories in just one click. Perfect for busy readers who want news on the go.

item.title: Gold Rates Today in India: Check city-wise prices; Is it right time to buy?
item.description: Gold prices declined on January 9, 2026, reflecting weakness in domestic and international markets. Rates fell across major Indian cities as profit booking and reduced safe-haven demand weighed on sentiment. Gold futures also slipped, tracking softer global cues ahead of key US economic data.

item.title: Iran protests intensify as internet and phone services shut down; Thousands detained
item.description: Protests in Iran have escalated sharply over rising inflation and a weakening currency. Thousands of demonstrators poured onto the streets across dozens of cities after an appeal by exiled Crown Prince Reza Pahlavi.

item.title: WPL 2026 First Match: MI vs RCB, date, time and live streaming; All updates here
item.description: The fourth season of the Women’s Premier League begins with a thrilling clash between Mumbai Indians and Royal Challengers Bengaluru. Indian stars Harmanpreet Kaur and Smriti Mandhana will lead their sides in the opening match at Navi Mumbai.

item.title: Stock Market Today: Sensex jumps 200 points, Nifty crosses 25,900; Click for details
item.description: Indian stock markets opened on a positive note despite weakness in the pre-opening session. The Sensex rose over 200 points, while the Nifty 50 moved above the 25,900 mark in early trade.

item.title: Why the Magh Mela holds great significance for Hindus? Here’s all you need to know
item.description: Magh Mela 2026 is one of the most sacred Hindu gatherings held at Prayagraj during the month of Magh. Devotees take holy dips at the Triveni Sangam, believing it washes away sins and leads to spiritual liberation.

item.title: US Senator threatens Iran’s Supreme leader amid rising tensions; Full details
item.description: Tensions between the United States and Iran have sharply escalated after Republican Senator Lindsey Graham issued a strong warning to Iran’s Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei. Referring to President Donald Trump, Graham said tough action could follow if Iranian authorities continue using violence against protesters.

item.title: Name Missing in UP SIR list? Here’s how to add it; Complete guide
item.description: The UP SIR Draft List 2026 has been released, with over 2.89 crore voters removed. Special Intensive Revision (SIR) removes deceased, duplicate, or shifted voters. Eligible voters can check their names online via the ECI website and submit Form 7 to add or correct details before February 6.

item.title: TMC MPs detained after protesting ED action in Bengal; Mamata Banerjee leads massive rally
item.description: TMC MPs, including Derek O’Brien and Mahua Moitra, were taken into custody after protesting the ED raid on I-PAC in Bengal. The party alleges that the action is politically motivated ahead of elections and targets their strategic documents and data.

item.title: Land-for-Job Scam Case: Delhi Court frames charges against Lalu, Rabri Devi, Tejashwi Yadav
item.description: Delhi’s Rouse Avenue Court has framed charges against former Bihar CM Lalu Prasad Yadav, Rabri Devi, Tejashwi Yadav, Misa Bharti, and others in the alleged land-for-job scam. CBI claims that between 2004–2009, railway jobs were given in exchange for land or properties in favor of Lalu’s family or associates.
